answers.core: AudioStreamPlayer2D feels like a core component
answers.workaround: Currently the workaround is just to set a very high max_distance and/or low attenuation value, but that's easy to forget and it would be easier and more consistent to just disable the distance fade all together if you don't want it.

title: Allow AudioStreamPlayer2D to have no distance falloff like AudioStreamPlayer3D with max_distance 0
